description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Fetch a public URL and return its main readable content as Markdown or plain text, plus title, author, published date and site name. Strips navigation, ads and boilerplate. No JavaScript rendering by default (cheaper than readfetch_scrape); one Chromium fallback when plain HTTP is blocked. Prefer readfetch_fetch when you need raw status, headers, or non-HTML bytes; readfetch_scrape when the article only appears after JavaScript runs.
